member.name: T:Sangam.Sdk.Worker.SangamWorker
member.summary:
External-worker runtime for the Sangam worker API (VI.3, A-1, A-2, R9, R20, R36).
Long-poll fetch-and-lock for all topics, asking only for free slots; fetch errors back off with jitter.
A-1: a handler starts only for items that came back LOCKED with a lockVersion and attemptId.
Heartbeat (extend-lock) every lease/3; the answer carries cancelRequested.
Fencing: every call carries (workerId, lockVersion, attemptId); 409 stale-lease / 410 gone means the lease is lost: the handler token is cancelled and its result discarded.
Idempotency-Key per call <operationId>:<action>:<lockVersion> (R41).
Result calls are retried until the lease expires; failures report decreasing retries and growing back-off.
Graceful shutdown: stops fetching, waits for in-flight handlers, then cancels the rest and unlocks their items.
